newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Asia Motors denies financial trouble talk.
newsitem.headline: Asia Motors denies financial trouble talk.

text.p: South Korea's Asia Motors on Thursday officially denied rumours of financial troubles which pushed its shares to a new yearly low in morning trading, the company said in a statement to the Korea Stock Exchange.
"Asia Motors is having no problem conducting financial transactions and there is no reason for its share price to drop," the statement said. There were no further details.

A company official said the stock exchange had asked Asia Motors to clarify the rumours, which have battered the company's stock all week. Asia acknowledged earlier that it had made a late debt payment on Monday.
Asia Motors dropped by its lower daily limit of 340 won, or 7.78 percent, to 4,030 at the start of trading on Thursday, but recovered slightly to close the morning at 4,150.
